choices.why: There is no mustard velvet sofa, so this warm cognac three-seater is the closest in tone, and at 193 cm it fits the long right wall facing the balcony without crowding it.
This natural woven rattan tub chair is the classic bohemian armchair and echoes the warm parquet floor.
This large tribal medallion rug in red, cream and multicolor brings the cheerful boho color asked for, and at 3 x 2.4 m it can sit under both the sofa and the chair.
Its orange, teal, plum and mustard blocks pick up the sofa and rug colors and add lively pattern to the sofa and the armchair.
The braided money tree gives real leafy height, one beside the balcony door and one in a corner, which makes the room feel lived-in.
This low, light-wood open shelf on legs fits under the back-wall window without blocking it and holds books and small plants.
A large, low round walnut table that suits the warm leather and the parquet, and sits nicely on the patterned rug.
The arc lamp reaches over the sofa from the side, and its warm linen drum shade adds a cozy glow to this rather dark room.
This tasseled geometric cotton throw adds a handmade bohemian texture draped over the cognac armrest.

answer.why: Warm cognac leather, natural rattan and walnut ground the room on the honey parquet, while the red tribal rug, multicolor cushions, tasseled throw and green plants add the joyful, layered, lived-in bohemian feel the user asked for.
